verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents substantial programmatic surface. The Query API returns the same calculated results seen in web-app reports and covers events, profiles, activity streams and cohorts. Alongside it sit raw event export, the Engage API, a Feature Flags API, JQL custom queries, GDPR deletion/retrieval APIs, and a hosted MCP server that can query reports and create dashboards. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and much of what is documented is read/export-oriented. Missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for configuration and management actions (e.g. Session Replay sampling, documented only as a UI control), a published OpenAPI spec (the probe returned 404 on all paths), an explicit parity statement, and independent hands-on corroboration.
